bulk input
Fastest option: tap load visible list, edit only the numbers, then apply. Format: bot | messages | collectors. You can also paste number-only rows like 257 | 1; those follow the current visible sort order. Applying only fills the form — it does not save yet.
bot messages collectors
loading bots…
Values start from the last known historical stand so you only need to change what changed. Unsaved M/C and event edits stay in place when you switch sorting, search, or show/hide later bots. Tap + event on a bot to add violation, ban, edit, avatar, web or booster on this date. new follows the creation date automatically. Saving confirms the date and syncs event edits when Events is unlocked. Blank M/C means unknown — never 0. Exact values like 802 stay exact. On mobile, 1,8 is read as ≈1.8K, or ≈1.8M when K would move backwards.
